استعجبن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَبْنَ (istaʕjabna) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# اِسْتَعْجِبْنَ (istaʕjibna) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
